description: Language neutral scenarios of the OFREP behaviour of the relay: serve flags.yaml, send the context to the evaluation of the flag and to the bulk evaluation, expect these results. body: fields of the response that must equal; absent: fields that must not be there; metadata: entries the metadata must contain; absentMetadata: entries the metadata must not contain; bulk: same (the bulk item has the same fields), error (the item has the errorCode and no value), omitted (no item). source: where the expectation comes from: spec (the pinned document or the OFREP text), provider (an official provider relies on it), relay (engine behaviour that neither defines); basis says why.

scenarios.name: static boolean
scenarios.basis: evaluationSuccess: key, value of a typed flag, variant, reason STATIC; context needs no targetingKey

scenarios.name: static string
scenarios.basis: evaluationSuccess: key, value of a typed flag, variant, reason STATIC; context needs no targetingKey

scenarios.name: static integer
scenarios.basis: evaluationSuccess: key, value of a typed flag, variant, reason STATIC; context needs no targetingKey

scenarios.name: static float
scenarios.basis: evaluationSuccess: key, value of a typed flag, variant, reason STATIC; context needs no targetingKey

scenarios.name: static object
scenarios.basis: evaluationSuccess: key, value of a typed flag, variant, reason STATIC; context needs no targetingKey

scenarios.name: static array
scenarios.basis: every official OFREP provider takes a JSON array as an object value; the pinned document types it as object (see the deviation in the validator)

scenarios.name: static empty array
scenarios.basis: every official OFREP provider takes a JSON array as an object value; the pinned document types it as object (see the deviation in the validator)

scenarios.name: static flag with an empty context
scenarios.basis: evaluationSuccess: key, value of a typed flag, variant, reason STATIC; context needs no targetingKey

scenarios.name: targeting rule match
scenarios.basis: reason TARGETING_MATCH is in the reason enum

scenarios.name: targeting rule miss falls to the default rule
scenarios.basis: the engine reason of a default rule is DEFAULT, mapped to STATIC because DEFAULT is not in the pinned reason enum

scenarios.name: targeting without the attribute
scenarios.basis: the engine reason of a default rule is DEFAULT, mapped to STATIC because DEFAULT is not in the pinned reason enum

scenarios.name: percentage rollout, first key
scenarios.basis: reason SPLIT is in the enum; which variant a key gets is the hashing of the engine

scenarios.basis: reason SPLIT is in the enum; which variant a key gets is the hashing of the engine

scenarios.name: rule with a percentage, rule misses
scenarios.basis: reason SPLIT is in the enum; which variant a key gets is the hashing of the engine

scenarios.name: disabled flag
scenarios.basis: reason DISABLED, and the value is absent as for codeDefaultFlag

scenarios.name: scheduled rollout that is over
scenarios.basis: scheduled rollouts are an engine feature; the reason after the last step is the engine's STATIC

scenarios.name: progressive rollout that is over
scenarios.basis: progressive rollouts are an engine feature; after the end date the end variation is a 100% split

scenarios.name: flag metadata
scenarios.basis: metadata is an object of boolean, string and number values

scenarios.name: flag metadata that is not a boolean, a string or a number
scenarios.basis: metadata: additionalProperties are booleans, strings or numbers: an object, a list or null entry of the flag is not sent

scenarios.name: flag not found
scenarios.basis: 404 with flagNotFound: key and errorCode FLAG_NOT_FOUND; JavaScript ofrep-core maps the failure body by errorCode

scenarios.name: rollout without a targeting key
scenarios.basis: 400 with evaluationFailure: errorCode TARGETING_KEY_MISSING is in the errorCode enum

scenarios.name: rollout with an empty targeting key
scenarios.basis: 400 with evaluationFailure: errorCode TARGETING_KEY_MISSING is in the errorCode enum

scenarios.name: rollout with a targeting key that is a number
scenarios.basis: the context schema types targetingKey as a string; how a wrong type is answered is the relay's choice
